g.text: Dynamic VIN selection: VBUS (USB) will override VBAT (LIPO) via D5 when both are present.

See: https://devzone.nordicsemi.com/blogs/943/measuring-lithium-battery-voltage-with-nrf52/ Maximum voltage: 4.2 V * (2 M/(0.8 M+2 M)) = 3 V Minimum voltage: 2.7 V * (2 M/(0.8 M+2 M)) = 1.93 V ADC value at 4.2 V - 12 bit setup: 3 V * (1/5) / 0.6 V * 4095 = 4095 ADC value at 2.7 V - 12 bit setup: 1.93 V * (1/5) / 0.6 V * 4095 = 2634 Usable ADC resolution - 12 bit setup: 4095 - 2634 = 1461
To charge the LIPO, insert the battery in the JST PH connector and connect USB at the same time.
MDBT42 QFN Bluetooth Low Energy Module nRF52832
